**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `options.retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Accept either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | Treat `undefined` as off |

The 8 remaining lines are real deprecations. `Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher` and more. Want me to clear those too?
